# 题迹 Questrace 2.0.0

## 中文说明

题迹 Questrace 2.0 是一个本地优先版本（原名 Notebook）。桌面程序内置网页界面和 Go 服务，使用 SQLite 与本地文件保存数据，目标电脑不再需要安装 MySQL、MinIO、Qdrant、Docker、Node.js 或 Go。

### 下载

- Windows x64 安装包：`Questrace-2.0.0-windows-x64-Setup.exe`（含安装向导、快捷方式和独立卸载程序）
- macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）和 Intel（x64）程序
- Linux amd64 和 arm64 压缩包
- Android APK
- 用于完整性校验的 `SHA256SUMS`

Android 包使用项目固定的 release 密钥签名。Windows 包使用项目自签名 Authenticode 证书，macOS 包使用 ad-hoc 签名且未经过 Apple 公证。因此首次启动时 Windows SmartScreen 或 macOS Gatekeeper 可能显示“未知发布者”警告；允许程序运行前，请先核对 `SHA256SUMS` 中对应文件的校验值。

### Windows 安装、退出与卸载

- Windows 发行包由便携版改为安装版；运行 `Setup.exe` 并按向导安装，之后通过桌面或开始菜单启动。
- 关闭窗口即退出并停止后台服务；服务停止超时时约 11 秒后强制结束，避免持续驻留。
- 从 Windows“设置 → 应用”、控制面板或安装目录中的 `Uninstall Questrace.exe` 卸载。
- 卸载向导默认勾选“保留用户数据”。取消勾选并确认后，删除当前用户 AppData 中本应用的数据、缓存及可识别的旧版 Notebook 数据；自定义数据目录保留。升级安装默认保留数据。
- 修复启动时缺少 `branding.cjs`、`data-dir.cjs` 的打包问题，以及 macOS 构建 Windows 卸载程序时的完整性校验错误。构建流程会校验安装包及内置卸载程序。

### 升级前须知

Notebook 2.0 **不会自动迁移** Notebook 1.x 的数据库或对象存储文件。现有 1.x 用户应保留原安装和数据。替换任何 2.0 安装前，请备份完整的 Questrace 数据目录（旧版可能仍为 Notebook）；备份中包含私人数据和模型密钥。

默认数据目录、备份命令和源码构建方式见仓库 [README](https://github.com/kukusuyi/Questrace/blob/master-v2.0/README.md)。仓库保留 iOS 源码及[编译说明](https://github.com/kukusuyi/Questrace/blob/master-v2.0/mobile/flutter_app/docs/IOS_SETUP.md)，但 v2.0.0 不提供 IPA 或 TestFlight 包。

完整变更见 [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/kukusuyi/Questrace/blob/master-v2.0/CHANGELOG.md)。

---

## English

Questrace 2.0 is a local-first release, formerly named Notebook. The desktop application bundles the web interface and Go service, stores data in SQLite and local files, and no longer requires MySQL, MinIO, Qdrant, Docker, Node.js or Go on the destination computer.

### Downloads

- Windows x64 installer: `Questrace-2.0.0-windows-x64-Setup.exe`, with a setup wizard, shortcuts and an uninstaller
- macOS applications for Apple Silicon (arm64) and Intel (x64)
- Linux archives for amd64 and arm64
- Android APK
- `SHA256SUMS` for integrity verification

Android packages use the project's persistent release key. Windows packages use a project self-signed Authenticode certificate, and macOS packages use ad-hoc signing without Apple notarization. Windows SmartScreen and macOS Gatekeeper may therefore show an untrusted-publisher warning on first launch; verify the matching `SHA256SUMS` entry before explicitly allowing the application.

### Windows installation, exit and uninstall

- Windows packages now use a setup wizard instead of a portable executable. Install with `Setup.exe`, then launch from the desktop or Start menu.
- Closing the window exits the application and stops its backend; a stalled shutdown is forcibly terminated after approximately 11 seconds.
- Uninstall through Windows Settings, Control Panel or `Uninstall Questrace.exe` in the installation directory.
- “Keep user data” is selected by default. Clearing it and confirming removes this application's data, cache and recognised legacy Notebook data from the current user's AppData. Custom data directories are preserved. Upgrades preserve data by default.
- Fixed missing startup modules (`branding.cjs` and `data-dir.cjs`) and invalid uninstaller checksums in Windows packages built on macOS. Builds now verify both the installer and its embedded uninstaller.

### Before upgrading

Notebook 2.0 does **not** automatically migrate Notebook 1.x databases or object-storage files. Existing 1.x users should keep their old installation and data intact. Back up the complete Questrace data directory (older installations may still use Notebook) before replacing any 2.0 installation; backups contain private data and model credentials.

The default data locations, backup commands and source-build instructions are documented in the repository [README](https://github.com/kukusuyi/Questrace/blob/master-v2.0/README.md). iOS source and [build instructions](https://github.com/kukusuyi/Questrace/blob/master-v2.0/mobile/flutter_app/docs/IOS_SETUP.md) are included, but v2.0.0 does not provide an IPA or TestFlight build.

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/kukusuyi/Questrace/blob/master-v2.0/CHANGELOG.md) for the full change summary.
